candidate_profile.name: Ankit Singh Tomar
candidate_profile.resume_text:
ANKIT SINGH TOMAR
Pune / Indore, India  •  +91 7999905480  •  tomarankit78@gmail.com  •  linkedin.com/in/ankit-singh-tomar  •  github.com/ankittomar9
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Application Support & Production Systems Engineer with ~3 years enterprise experience at Cognizant managing 24/7 operational reliability, L2/L3 incident response, and observability for Macy's financial transaction platform (2M–4M daily transactions). Hands-on expertise in Splunk, ELK (Kibana), Grafana, Prometheus, Linux CLI, ServiceNow (P1–P4 SLAs), Oracle SQL, BMC Control-M batch jobs, and distributed messaging (TIBCO, IBM MQ). Architected AI Interview OS with full observability stacks. Awarded 5/5 ratings for consecutive years. Available immediately for 100% remote rotational shifts.
TECHNICAL SKILLS
•  Monitoring & Observability: Splunk, ELK Stack (Kibana), BareTail, TIBCO GEMS, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, APM, Server Metrics, Log Analysis
•  Incident Management & ITSM: ServiceNow (Incident, Problem, Change, SLAs), Jira Service Management, 24/7 Rotational Shifts, Shift Handover, RCA Documentation, SOPs
•  Systems, DB & Middleware: Linux (RHEL/CentOS, SSH, PuTTY, Bash), Windows Server, Oracle (11g/19c), SQL, BMC Control-M, TIBCO EMS, IBM MQ, REST APIs, HTTP, GCP BigQuery, OCI
•  Engineering & Automation: Java (Core, JAX-WS), Spring Boot, Docker, Docker Compose, Git, Postman API Testing, Microsoft Power Automate Alerting
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Cognizant Technology Solutions  |  Application Support & Production Systems Engineer (Client: Macy's)  |  Oct 2021 – Jul 2024
•  Production Monitoring & SLA Ownership: Owned 24/7 L2/L3 production monitoring and incident response for Data Collect Repository (DCR), processing 2M+ daily transactions (3M–4M peak days); maintained strict P1 SLAs (5–10 min acknowledgment, <100 min resolution) with only 1–2 escalations over tenure.
•  Incident Triage & Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigated application, API, and message queue bottlenecks using Splunk, Kibana, BareTail, and TIBCO GEMS; authored comprehensive RCA post-mortems and managed incident tracking through ServiceNow.
•  Database & Batch Job Reconciliation: Diagnosed and resolved a critical post-migration duplication incident under composite keys (Date, Store, Terminal, Register): executed surgical Oracle 11g SQL scripts to remediate 5,000–10,000 records across a 3-hour peak window without DB downtime.
•  BMC Control-M Batch Administration: Monitored and executed automated Control-M reconciliation batch jobs comparing POS, DCR, and mainframe financial records; queried Oracle and GCP BigQuery to detect stalled transactions and initiated approved replay workflows.
•  High-Availability Infrastructure & OCI Migration: Maintained a 16-server cluster (8 Active / 8 Failover); scripted dev/UAT deployments, supported production SSH/RDP releases under change tickets, and verified post-release health checks, connectivity, and failovers.
•  Proactive Alerting & Middleware Management: Built IBM MQ queue depth monitoring in Splunk and automated instant alert notifications to Microsoft Teams and email using Power Automate; maintained JAX-WS XML/XSD consumer pipelines routing to 10+ downstreams.
•  Operations, SOPs & Daylight-Saving Support: Maintained standard operating procedures (SOPs), handled manual SSL/TLS certificate renewals, managed bi-annual Daylight Saving Time job scheduling adjustments, and led operational shift handovers; rated 5/5 in 2022 and 2023 appraisals.
Independent Technical Work & Career Break  |  Aug 2024 – Present
Career break for a family medical situation (fully resolved; available to join immediately for rotational shifts).
•  AI Training & Technical Data Contributor: Produced technical video walkthroughs and validation labs on Docker containerization, Spring Data JPA, and security configurations on Scaler's Taggr platform (4 approved tasks).
•  System Design & Certification: Completed advanced Java Backend and Distributed Systems Certification from Scaler Academy (Oct 2024).
FEATURED SYSTEMS PROJECT
AI Interview OS — Distributed Technical Evaluation Platform  |  github.com/ankittomar9/ai-interview-os
•  Full-Stack Observability & Health Probes: Integrated Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki distributed telemetry across 8 Spring Cloud microservices; implemented automated preflight capability probes, API health checks, and scheduled storage cleanup routines.
•  Containerized Execution Sandboxes: Built isolated execution runtime using Judge0 with Linux cgroup/ptrace resource limits (CPU/memory throttling) and ephemeral, network-disabled Docker Maven containers with whitelisted execution paths.
•  Reliability & Test Automation: Established 3-provider failover chains (Gemini, Groq, OpenAI) with explicit error fallback states and a verified suite of 116 test files, 681 test cases, and 2,605 automated assertions.
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS
•  Bachelor of Technology, Computer Science & Engineering  —  Shri Vaishnav Vidyapeeth Vishwavidyalaya (CGPA: 8.6/10, 2017–2021)
•  Certifications: Java Certification (Scaler Academy, Oct 2024)  •  Spring Boot Microservices, Spring Cloud & TDD (Specialized Training)
